name: Master of Science in Physics (Research-Oriented)
applicationDeadline:
The application deadline for the summer semester (lectures beginning in April of a given calendar year) is 1 March.

The application deadline for the winter semester (lectures beginning in October of a given calendar year) is 1 September.  

Please be aware that you will have to submit your academic certificates for recognition, which should be done in advance of the above deadlines (six weeks is recommended). The certificate recognition process is a separate step from the MSc application and must be done first.

Applications are processed year-round.

If you require a student visa, please take note of the visa processing times for the German embassy in your country.
